title: Add a command to a package

package.description: The package folder name under packages/.

name.description: The command name, in kebab case, such as archive-invoice.

model.description: The model that the local change writes, such as invoice. It must exist.

waits.description: local: the screen shows the change at once. server: the screen waits for the server.

access.description: organization: any actor of the organization may run it. group: the actor must be allowed the sync group of the record it writes.
